description: This file defines the ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector class, which implements placement logic for Orleans silos based on resource utilization metrics. It includes methods for selecting silos for activation placement, normalizing weights, and handling silo statistics updates.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements resource-aware silo placement strategy for Orleans, considering CPU, memory, and activation count metrics to optimize activation distribution across silos.

methods.name: NormalizeWeights
methods.description: Calculates normalized weights for resource metrics based on input options.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the best silo to place a new activation based on resource metrics and silo status.

methods.name: MakePick
methods.description: Selects a candidate silo from a list of compatible silos based on resource scores.

methods.name: ShufflePrefix
methods.description: Shuffles the first 'prefixLength' elements of a span of silos to introduce randomness.

methods.name: CalculateScore
methods.description: Calculates a resource-based score for a silo to aid in placement decisions.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Removes a silo's statistics from the internal tracking.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates silo resource statistics upon receiving new data.
